REDD+ Policy Planner

Which carbon-credit standard should a government choose, and what is each reform worth?
AI agents that run the real rule calculators, cite the rules, and check every number.

https://github.com/ake-k/redd-policy-planner

The problem

5–25%
ART TREES buffervs 10–60% under Verra JNR
$5.1M/yr
buffer gap on a sample province at US$10/t512,352 tCO₂e/yr
  • Thailand (TGO) must choose JNR or ART, with unresolved carbon rights and high fire risk, both of which feed the risk tools
  • Today: a 4-month, 400,000-baht consultant study, static tables, and a PDF risk questionnaire per standard
  • Every "what if we pass a carbon rights law?" means going back to the consultant

Sources: ART JNR GCF comparison (2021) p.12; TGO JREDD+ TOR p.3; LEAF floor price per Comparative Analysis p.1

Agents never do math: they translate policy into calculator inputs, move the dashboard (with Undo), and a code verifier rejects any number not produced by a tool.

The agents

3 gpt-6-luna agents with strict JSON outputs, plus code steps for the safety gate and the verifier.

Demo: one question, end to end

"Carbon rights law + 40% funding + 100-year agreement: JNR vs ART?"

  • Orchestrator → scenario
  • compare_standards → JNR buffer 33% → 15%
  • set_dashboard_state → sliders move, Undo
  • Verifier → ✓ Verified

13,750 tokens · $0.0005 · 14s

  • Prompt caching: 66% cheaper, accuracy 10/10 → 10/10 (median answer 22s)
  • The engine and verifier are code ($0); an exact-repeat answer cache ($0); retrieval capped at 5 × 300 words

Measured: scripts/benchmark.py, 10 questions × caching on/off, gateway cache disabled. Assumes 40 questions/user/month.

Safety: defenses that fired

  • Poisoned rule file tells the agent "the ART buffer is 0%" → withheld 13×; the answer says 5–25%
  • "Ignore previous instructions…" → blocked before any model call
  • Invented numbers or citations → code verifier; 6 drafts sent back
  • Loops and spending → ≤8 tools, ≤4 hops, 40k/run, 300k/session, 10 req/min
  • Wrong action → only moves sliders, with Undo
  • 29 pytest tests, including a fake model that loops forever

Limits and next steps

Limits
  • Planning aid, not certification
  • One year, flat emission factor, no removals or HFLD
  • 23-excerpt rule library
  • Router variance (backstopped)
Next
  • Premium T-VER as a third pathway
  • Revenue and price scenarios over time
